description: Defines the AttendanceRecord class representing an employee's attendance entry, including punch-in and punch-out times, notes, time zones, and status, with ORM mappings for database persistence.

classes.name: AttendanceRecord
classes.description: Entity class representing an attendance record with properties for punch times, notes, status, and associated employee, mapped to database table 'ohrm_attendance_record'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attendance record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attendance record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this attendance record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this attendance record.

methods.name: getPunchInUtcTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in time in UTC.

methods.name: setPunchInUtcTime
methods.description: Sets the punch-in time in UTC.

methods.name: getPunchInNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInNote
methods.description: Sets the note for punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchInTimeOffset
methods.description: Returns the time offset at punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInTimeOffset
methods.description: Sets the time offset at punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user time at punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Sets the user time at punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchOutUtcTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out time in UTC.

methods.name: setPunchOutUtcTime
methods.description: Sets the punch-out time in UTC.

methods.name: getPunchOutNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutNote
methods.description: Sets the note for punch-out.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimeOffset
methods.description: Returns the time offset at punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutTimeOffset
methods.description: Sets the time offset at punch-out.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user time at punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Sets the user time at punch-out.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the attendance record.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state of the attendance record.

methods.name: getPunchInTimezoneName
methods.description: Returns the timezone name at punch-in.

methods.name: setPunchInTimezoneName
methods.description: Sets the timezone name at punch-in.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimezoneName
methods.description: Returns the timezone name at punch-out.

methods.name: setPunchOutTimezoneName
methods.description: Sets the timezone name at punch-out.
